summary: Verified new guest (no-signup) mock interview at /free-trial/{trialId}. Backend: 15/15 pytest passing across /api/guest-sim/{trial_id}/{sim,application,aptitude/start,aptitude/submit,interview/begin,interview/answer,case/submit,tts} incl. validation errors (400/409) and aptitude LLM polling (took ~30s). Frontend: direct URL to /free-trial/{tid} renders GuestInterviewPlayer with JPM firm header, guest-back-home link, guest-trial-badge, StageTracker with 6 stage pills (Application active), NO sidebar, NO old free-trial-continue-btn. State persists on reload via localStorage 'guest-sim:{trialId}'. Invalid trial id (with '!' chars) shows friendly error page (guest-sim-error), does not crash.

integration_issues.issue: Could not fully E2E-test the landing form submission because /api/free-trial/start returns 409 'Free trial already used on this device' due to IP/fingerprint throttle in the shared test environment. The client-side code (FreeTrialCTA.jsx line 66: nav(`/free-trial/${j.trial_id}`)) is correct and the target route was verified to render the guest player directly. Not a regression — but note the trial gating is IP-based and cannot be bypassed by localStorage.clear() alone.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider allowing repeat trials from same IP if email is unique (or expose an admin reset) to make end-to-end preview testing easier.
critical_code_review_comments: guest_interview_sim_endpoints.py aptitude cache is in-memory and per-worker — if backend has >1 worker or restarts between /aptitude/start and /aptitude/submit, submit returns 409. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting for load-balanced deploys.

GuestInterviewPlayer.jsx uses raw localStorage for state; no schema version key — a future breaking change to state shape could crash old tabs. Consider adding a 'v': 1 field and bumping on incompat changes.

TTS + application/case LLM calls are unauthenticated and hit the Emergent LLM key from any origin — free-trial gating is IP-based (in /api/free-trial/start) but /api/guest-sim/{trial_id}/* accepts any regex-matching trial_id with no server-side allow-list. A scraper can burn LLM quota via /guest-sim/*/tts or /interview/answer. Consider rate-limiting per IP or requiring a signed trial token.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (direct-URL guest player fully verified; landing CTA network call blocked by device throttle)

test_credentials: No auth required for guest-sim endpoints. Trial id: any string matching ^[A-Za-z0-9@._+-]{3,200}$.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The new /api/guest-sim/{trial_id}/* endpoints and /free-trial/{trialId} route work. Aptitude uses async LLM generation — first POST returns {pending:true, poll_seconds:3} and questions arrive after ~30s. TTS reuses OpenAI TTS via emergentintegrations. Do NOT run full 30-min interview in tests. The landing CTA (/api/free-trial/start) is IP-throttled; use direct URL /free-trial/{any_valid_string} to reach guest player.
